ModMetaData.name: Wave Survival Reforged
ModMetaData.author: AzraelGodKing, Justin C (original), Philbro (art)
ModMetaData.description:
A RimWorld 1.6 and 1.7 rebuild of Wave Survival [Game Mode] by Justin C.
The Wave Survival storyteller is a combat run. Random events are off. Raids arrive on a timer, and each wave is stronger than the last. Every fourth wave is special: a siege, sappers, breachers, mechanoids or maddened animals. Every tenth is a boss wave. A supply pod lands at your orbital trade beacon every day.
- The next wave is decided ahead of time: the alert and a small HUD tell you what is coming and from whom. - Casual, Standard, Brutal or Custom presets, saved with each run. - Daily steel, wood, stone blocks, silver, components and medicine. Survival meals when food is low, and the occasional weapon. - Royalty and Anomaly add their own waves. Add your own in Defs/WaveTypes.xml. - Run stats and a best-runs list. - On RimWorld 1.7, the screen edges glow as a wave gets close. - Wave Survival scenario: 4 colonists, starting weapons, turret research finished.
No other mods required. Multiplayer is not supported.
Original mod by Justin C. Storyteller art by Philbro: http://philbro.deviantart.com/ Discord: https://discord.gg/Vwh2y7qMXv
